name: Topaz Sharpen
description: Produces clear images with crisp details. Unlike traditional sharpening that darkens or brightens pixel edges, it reverses the root causes of blurriness, such as camera shake, motion blur, and missed focus.

action.description: Produces clear images with crisp details. Unlike traditional sharpening that darkens or brightens pixel edges, it reverses the root causes of blurriness, such as camera shake, motion blur, and missed focus.
action.name: topaz-sharpen
action.searchText: topaz sharpen  topaz sharpen upscale upscaler

face_enhancement.description: By default, faces (if any) are enhanced during image processing as well. Set `face_enhancement` to `false` if you don't want this.
face_enhancement.title: Face Enhancement

face_enhancement_creativity.description: Choose the level of creativity for face enhancement from 0 to 1. Defaults to `0`, and is ignored if `face_enhancement` is `false`.
face_enhancement_creativity.title: Face Enhancement Creativity

face_enhancement_strength.description: Control how sharp the enhanced faces are relative to the background from 0 to 1. Defaults to `0.8`, and is ignored if `face_enhancement` is `false`.
face_enhancement_strength.title: Face Enhancement Strength

image.description:
The image file to be processed. Supported formats:
* jpeg (or jpg)
* png
* tiff (or tif)
image.title: Image

model.description: The model to use for processing the image.
model.title: Model

output_format.description: The desired format of the output image.
output_format.title: Output Format

subject_detection.description: Specifies whether you want to detect all subjects in the image, only the foreground subject, or only the background for the AI model to run on.
subject_detection.title: Subject Detection
